take_homes: Don't pick what to share by what's easy to build. Interview one teammate about how they do the job today, and treat their current spreadsheet or gut call as the competitor.
Find the one obstacle that, once removed, loosens the others. Draft the technical plan and the people plan together, and a people plan with unnamed roles is not finished.
Ask what would have to be true for them to switch, then test two or three of those conditions this week, starting with a conversation.

monday.move: Talk to the analyst who would pick up my pilot-cohort brief. Ask how they build that brief today and what would make them use the agent version. Test one assumption: it has to land in the doc they already open.
monday.who: One analyst on my team of fourteen, the one who currently writes the pricing working group update
monday.when: Monday morning, 30 minutes, before I re-run the brief with fresh data
monday.stop_condition: If they say their current process works and name no gap, I drop this candidate and look for a different teammate and job.
monday.blocker: We have no shared place for the context files, so everyone keeps their own copy. Even if the conversation goes well, I have nowhere to put the result.
